creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5)
method: scale_renders.mjs composes the room-only @1x render with the cleaned native figures and their separated ground shadows (premultiplied area-average, uniform downscale only, depth by feet y), crops camera frames from candidates/m1.0g-construction/frames.json (camera-framing.ts sha256 3c7714d2… unchanged), and measures each character from its own mask at alpha ≥ 50%. sheet_jc.py lays the renders out 1:1 in Krita.
inputs: ground shadows from the M1.0j-B extraction (re-run of extract2.mjs; native offset Boy (18, 9), Mom (−11, 10))
